name: Your Name
tagline: I break systems to understand them, then teach models to defend them.
summary: I work where machine learning meets security: training models on messy real-world telemetry, then pressure-testing the systems those models run inside. Most of what I build starts as a question I could not find a good answer to, and ends as something I can hand to someone else and have it keep working.
interests: Automating the boring half of vulnerability research
goals: Publish a reproducible benchmark for intrusion-detection models on modern traffic
Contribute upstream to an open-source security tool I use every week
Move from building models to shipping them under real production constraints
